errors.target: Target must be between 50 and 100,000 kg
errors.datePast: Pickup cannot be in the past

builder.created: {{code}} created — farmers are asked to consent
builder.seoDescription: Find compatible harvests and group them into a buyer-ready lot.
builder.title: Pool small harvests into one buyer-ready lot
builder.description: Set the crop, grade and collection point. MandiMate proposes compatible farms by distance, freshness and quality — you adjust, then ask each farmer to consent.
builder.demandHint: Optional — pre-fills crop, grade, quantity and pickup date
builder.emptyBody: Set the criteria and preview. You will see the farms MandiMate would pool, the ones it left out and why, and whether the lot reaches its target.
builder.stale: Criteria changed since this preview. Refresh the match before creating the lot.
builder.shortfall: Shortfall {{kg}} kg · minimum to proceed {{min}} kg
builder.mapBody: Pickup order starts at the farthest farm and ends at the collection point.
builder.selectedBody: Adjust kilograms per farm (never more than they have) or switch a farm off.
builder.noneSelected: No farms selected. Switch on a compatible farm below.
builder.compatibleBody: These farms fit the criteria but were not needed to reach the target.

list.seoDescription: Every pooled lot, from forming to settled.
list.title: Lots
list.description: Each lot gathers small harvests into one buyer-ready consignment. Track consent, offers and delivery from here.
list.searchPlaceholder: Code, crop, buyer or collection point
list.emptyBody: Pool listed harvests in the lot builder to create the first one.

cockpit.seoDescription: Members, consent, offers, transport, delivery and settlement for this lot.
cockpit.error: This lot could not be loaded
cockpit.dealConsentBody: You accepted {{price}}/kg. The deal is final once every farmer has answered; anyone who declines leaves the lot.
cockpit.joinConsentBody: Each farmer confirms their kilograms join this lot. It opens to buyers automatically once nobody is pending.
cockpit.offers: Offers, compared on what farmers keep
cockpit.offersBody: Net per kg is after transport, handling, commission, expected rejection and payment delay.
cockpit.noOffersOpen: Buyers can see this lot now. Offers appear here as they come in.
cockpit.noOffersClosed: Open the lot for offers once farmers have agreed to pool.
cockpit.openPending: {{count}} farmers have not answered yet. Buyers will see the {{kg}} kg already agreed.
cockpit.openBody: Verified buyers can now make offers on this lot.
cockpit.cancelBody: Every farmer’s harvest returns to their own listing and open offers are closed. This cannot be undone.

consent.assistedBody: Assisted consent for {{subject}}. Recorded in the audit log under your name — only do this when the farmer has told you directly.

offers.awaitingBuyer: Your counter is with the buyer

offer.seoDescription: Negotiation, net proceeds per farmer and the next step on a lot offer.
offer.error: This offer could not be loaded
offer.consentBody: The deal is final once every member has answered. Record consent only for farmers who told you directly.
offer.breakdownBody: Gross price less transport, handling, commission, expected rejection and payment delay.
offer.suggestBody: A rules-based price from mandi rates and the farmers’ floors, worded by AI.
offer.suggestOnlySeller: Available while the offer waits on you.

transport.buyerPickup: The buyer collects from {{point}} and pays for transport — no truck to arrange. Delivery can be recorded straight away.
transport.afterDeal: Transport is arranged once a buyer’s offer is accepted. You can preview the route now.
transport.title: Transport
transport.requested: Transport requested — transporters can now quote

delivery.title: Delivery & quality
delivery.none: Delivery has not been recorded yet. Weigh and inspect at the buyer, then record it from the transport desk.

accept.done: Accepted — farmers are now asked to consent
accept.title: Accept {{price}}/kg from {{buyer}}?
accept.description: The deal becomes a proposal. Every member farmer must consent before it is final — you can record consent for farmers who confirm by phone.

reject.title: Reject the offer from {{buyer}}?
reject.description: The buyer is told the lot declined. Other offers stay open.
